verdict.rationale: Rippling IT is an identity and access management product, so a queryable, exportable identity event log is a fair axis. The evidence shows only a generic v2 REST API (bearer tokens, pagination), real-time monitoring claims, and custom reports. Nothing documents a structured system or audit log of identity events, an API endpoint for querying those events, or native streaming to a SIEM. A general API and dashboards are adjacent features and earn no credit here.
